name: red
purpose: C059 fix RED, group server, extension of run-4 for the two controller additions (orders\_PIPELINING.md, 'TWO MORE HOLES FOUND BY rev-C017'): a request PIPELINED BEHIND A REFUSAL must never run, also behind the answers NODE gives by itself (unknown Expect 417, a request without Host, clientError: malformed version, invalid header line, header overflow 431, invalid chunk size, Content-Length together with Transfer-Encoding, 100-continue) and in the HTTP/1.0 framing (maxRequestsPerSocket is not applied to it). Raw sockets against the service AS PUBLISHED in 14cefdea (stubs-4/server.cjs is that file byte for byte, loaded by helpers-4/old-server-loader.cjs) in a SEPARATE child process, ONE write per case: [refusal][valid submit] in the four framing pairs (R and M each HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/1.0) for 28 rows, [GET][refusal][submit], the two-writes variants, chunked and Expect: 100-continue submits, a quota-full engine rejection, and a parse error with a request in flight (the service in process with the held executor). The run is a reduced selection of tests\pipelining.test.cjs (the published service keeps every connection open for its one second keep-alive bound, so the full matrix would take minutes): on the published service the valid submit behind the refusal RUNS, the connection is kept open and Node's own answers are untyped. Replay: C059_RED_SUBJECT=capability\C059\evidence\red\stubs-4.
